name: sextant
description: A sextant with a graduated sector, angled index arm and short telescope.
useCase: Identify a sextant for measuring angles in celestial navigation.
misuse: Use protractor for a semicircular drawing or angle tool.

16.reason: A broad curved sector and two scale ticks stay clear beside the full angled index arm.

24.reason: The larger sector keeps its complete graduations and angled arm beside the telescope tube.
